method: every image opened and visually inspected by the intake agent; no OCR call, no provider call — text read directly from the rendered photograph
notes: No GROUP_INVENTORY photograph is present in this ZIP — all 23 images show a single product.

No image contains a calibration target (ruler, scale card, grid). Every image is handheld perspective photography, therefore no image qualifies as CALIBRATION_VIEW and none is suitable for extracting physical dimensions.
Several near-axial top/bottom views are useful for cross-section SHAPE evidence only, never for dimensions.
A handwritten note on the backing paper (visible in IMG_3111, IMG_3113, IMG_3115, IMG_3118) reads approximately 'P4: t.height…' — partially legible, recorded as a non-evidentiary owner working note.
All body/EXIF metadata per file is in source_manifest.json.
